title: No WordPress theme tree carries content under a number already released from TracyHQ/claude-cowork: tracy 1.1.5, WP Kinetic 1.1.12 and WP Morgan 1.1.14 take the changes made after their 1.1.4, 1.1.11 and 1.1.13 releases
steps: S1: For each theme with a release on 10/10/2026 (tracy, tracy-base, wp-ja-essence, wp-ja-impact, wp-ja-kinetic, wp-ja-morgan, wp-ja-nova, wp-ja-vega, wp-tracy-business) read the version its tree declares (packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/package.json for tracy, overlays/<slug>/theme.config.json otherwise) and the Version line of src/<slug>/style.css.

S2: Compare the declared version with that theme's newest release (recorded in the script: version, tag, and the sha256 digest of the released zip's theme folder, every file's path and sha256, update.json, tracy-release.json and .DS_Store left out). Same number: digest src/<slug> the same way and compare. Otherwise: is the declared number later?
S3: For wp-ja-essence, wp-ja-kinetic and wp-ja-morgan (the three whose readme.txt keeps a changelog), read the first '= x.y.z =' heading after '== Changelog ==' in src/<slug>/readme.txt.
expect: S1: every style.css Version equals the declared version.

S2: tracy, wp-ja-kinetic and wp-ja-morgan declare a number after their releases 1.1.4, 1.1.11 and 1.1.13 (1.1.5, 1.1.12 and 1.1.14 on this branch); wp-ja-essence (1.0.11) and wp-ja-vega (1.1.14) declare a number after 1.0.10 and 1.1.13; tracy-base 1.1.5, wp-ja-impact 1.0.8, wp-ja-nova 1.1.11 and wp-tracy-business 1.1.7 still declare their release's number and their src tree's digest equals the released zip's.
S3: each changelog opens with the declared version.
evidence: 10/10/2026: scripts/sync-cms-themes.mjs --check against claude-cowork main faf6ec2 reported tracy (823 files here, 822 there), wp-ja-kinetic and wp-ja-morgan out of date while each still declared its released number. Against the released zips: tracy 1.1.4 lacked inc/brand-logo.php and the functions.php of #879 (contact form mails only a configured recipient) and a2f40f706 (dark-background logo, site name as text); wp-ja-kinetic 1.1.11 and wp-ja-morgan 1.1.13 lacked the readme changelog entry a735e0294 (#1092) added at 14:46 UTC, an hour after both were released at 13:44 UTC. On 8323b61f7 the script's S2 fails for those three.
fence: Static read of the committed versions and built trees against a snapshot of the releases taken on 10/10/2026; a release cut after that date is not known to the script, so it guards the numbers released by then
